en.askTitle: Swap in your own date, guest count and budget to get the same legal-route and venue comparison for your Lake Como wedding
en.runTitle: A Singapore couple’s Lake Como wedding for 80 guests on EUR 85,000

fields.label: Guest count
fields.value: About 80 guests, flying in mostly from Singapore and India

fields.label: Gross budget
fields.value: EUR 85,000 for the wedding itself, excluding guests’ own travel

fields.label: Ceremony, dietary and accessibility needs
fields.value: A Hindu-style ceremony element and a western-style reception, with vegetarian Indian catering

en.template: Help us plan a Singapore legal solemnisation and symbolic Lake Como celebration for {date}, {guests} and {budget}. Our essential ceremony, dietary and accessibility needs are {details}. Compare exclusive event-space options, indoor plans, transport and full commitments; keep contingency separate and flag unresolved documents, fire and menu permissions. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms, booking or paying.

phases.title: Read the official marriage, venue and guest-visa rules without contacting anyone
phases.note: Italian and Singapore marriage paperwork, venue price examples, Schengen visa lead times
phases.judgment: It would not treat a Singapore marriage-record search as a substitute for the Italian no-impediment paperwork: the official pages do not say it is accepted, so the guide frames “marry in Singapore first” as a risk call, not proof that marrying in Italy is impossible.

phases.title: Build the guide, the source register and an itemised budget
phases.note: Legal-route comparison, venues with dated prices, timeline and a line-by-line budget
phases.judgment: It labelled every secondary venue price as unconfirmed and said plainly that no venue it looked at has confirmed permission for a ceremonial fire.

phases.title: Independent re-check of every money figure, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed every budget row and every venue calculation, all passed, and then said the guide is a decision-stage tool, not a confirmed, available €85,000 wedding. The plan came to €84,194 including a 10% reserve, €806 under the ceiling.

workers: Found dated price and capacity evidence for villas, restaurants and hotels around Como, Bellagio and Varenna for 80 guests
Read the official Italian town-hall and Singapore marriage-registry pages to compare marrying legally in Italy with marrying in Singapore first
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked the guide’s claims against the source register
